logic_errors: startProceduralGame() has no try/catch — if the procedural fallback (called from startAIGame's catch block) itself fails, the exception propagates unhandled and the user is stuck on GENERATING phase with no error screen
retryGame() sets phase=GamePhase.MENU before calling startGame(), causing a brief blank-screen flicker (MENU falls into 'else -> {}' in GameScreen's when block) before GENERATING phase kicks in

startAIGame() only checks generated.imageUrl — the new imageBytes and localPath fields on GeneratedImage are never read, so even if a provider populated them the game would still fall through to procedural generation
suggestions: Replace 3 new println() calls in GameViewModel (startAIGame fallback + downloadImage) with a KMP-compatible logger (e.g., Napier or Kermit) to avoid console spam in production
Wrap startProceduralGame() in its own try/catch or add catch to startAIGame's fallback path to set ERROR phase when even procedural generation fails
Remove the unused GeneratedImage.imageBytes field (added in this cycle but never populated or read) to avoid dead code
Simplify retryGame() to set phase directly to GENERATING instead of MENU→GENERATING to eliminate the blank-frame flicker
PreferencesFactory.androidContext (type Any?) is misleadingly named — it holds Android Context; consider renaming to platformContext or using expect class for the factory itself
The Android SoundManager TODO(v1.1) KDoc is placed only above playPieceSelect() rather than on each play*() method individually; add per-method TODOs for clarity per the spec
Add a check for generated.localPath in startAIGame() to support providers that return local file paths (completing the GeneratedImage contract)
summary: Cycle 1 changes are largely spec-compliant with solid KMP correctness, but the startAIGame fallback path has an unguarded procedural-generation call that can silently fail, and the MockAIImageProvider was not updated to generate real bitmaps as specified in Task 1.6 — functionally masked by the fallback but a spec gap.
